metadata.source_note: Minimal contract for a local-only bridge from explicit self untapped-status conditions to local ACTION:DRAW_CARDS enablement already recognized in the same profile.

bridge_kind.label: tapped_status -> local_enablement
bridge_kind.status_signal_source: explicit self untapped condition in oracle text
bridge_kind.purpose: Capture explicit local enablement where self untapped status conditions co-exist with local ACTION:DRAW_CARDS in the same profile.

activation_scope.description: Bridge applies only inside the same card/profile.

required_local_signals: Explicit self status condition using untapped wording
status_condition_patterns: for as long as this artifact|creature|permanent is untapped
as long as this artifact|creature|permanent is untapped
activation_predicate.text_evidence_policy: Require explicit local untapped status-condition phrasing and do not infer from incidental tapped mentions.

non_goals: Explicit self tapped conditions are out of scope in v1
Downstream actions other than ACTION:DRAW_CARDS are out of scope in v1
Enters tapped or becomes tapped incidental text
Summoning sickness or TAP/Q legality rework
